results.title: Resource-refinement monotonicity for total-variation distinction
results.statement: For every stochastic coarse-graining K, D_TV(Kp,Kq) <= D_TV(p,q).

results.title: Sharp revelation-increment bound
results.statement: For nested resource records, 0 <= Delta = D_fine-D_coarse <= 1-D_coarse; both bounds are sharp.

results.title: Conservation of accessible distinction under arbitrary refinement
results.statement: The equality D_fine = D_coarse for all refinements is false.

next_strong_target: Derive a non-tautological PDT-native total-distinction exchange/conservation law including controlled environmental records, or falsify that route.
